newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Turners and Growers sells Viaduct land.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Turners and Growers sells Viaduct land.

text.p: Turners and Growers said on Wednesday it had entered an unconditional contract for the sale of various properties in downtown Auckland for NZ$17 million.
Turners is 42 percent owned by Guinness Peat Group Ltd. The proceeds would be used to allow Turners to concentrate on its core businesses, Chairman Tony Gibbs said.
The sale was to Heng Holdings (S.E.A) Pte Ltd.

The deal comprises the Old Markets Building, the New Markets Building and the Jaybell Carpark, covering about 2.4 hectares of land directly overlooking the Viaduct Basin and the adjacent proposed America's Cup facilities.

Heng's Executive Director Tony Heng said the group is now the major shareholder in Pacific Development and Investment Corp Ltd. Heng said he was attracted by the site's unique location and the development planning work completed to date by Pacific.
Development was expected to start later this year for completion to coincide with year 2000 activities.
